title: Conditional κ = 0.001138823042306561: retain rank138 with complete 32-replica banks
body:
Conditional **κ = 0.001138823042306561** (`1138823042306561 / 10^18`). This retains two rank-one kernel pivots that eight-replica bank packing discarded. Thirty-two independent replicas fill every width-64 bank exactly, admitting entrance rank 138 without padding. The bit lower endpoint is `0.001140121438872176364117`.

This is about **0.00219% above #441** at `6160c13526f5f957902910b462164c93c1d8f39a`. **#442 reports a larger bound using its additional idle-data hosting extension.** This PR isolates replica banking within the preceding helper-bank interface and supplies a construction that can be composed with later hosting work.

The word starts from #436's R740 producer, uses 57 primitive A-frame changes and a re-derived 114-pivot/103-donor kernel, then independently rechecks #441's paired and window B-frame choices on the new word. The scalar ADD operands and order are preserved by retiming. Sixteen explicit residual isometries place 32 replicas into 2,891 complete banks per stage: 56,739 live and 56,748 physical families, deficit 9,984.

Validation: full Linux verifier and macOS cross-check pass; native `make verify-joint` passes (16 tests). The release checks pinned source bytes, complete parent reconstruction, frozen transformations, all 980 local arbitrary-dirt columns, both reflected streams, the one-replica 7,620-column global identity, all 288 emitted invocations and 213,120 helper assignments, exact projectors and residual routes, five reconstruction controls, 14 template mutations, two rational moment engines, a fresh finite invoice, six bootstrap levels and 47 strict outer inequalities. The prefix needs 123 bits (charged 128); the two-level coefficient needs 286 bits (charged 512). Eight-replica admission of the untrimmed selection is explicitly rejected. The adjacent 10^-18 κ grid point is rejected.

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r research/e8-r740-replica32/parent436/requirements.txt
bash research/e8-r740-replica32/verify.sh /tmp/e8-r740-replica32-full
```

The complex lower endpoint `0.001183986549206329` is cited from #433; its Gaussian phases are not replayed by this package. The all-size compiler, correlated dirty-bank, compressed-window, restored-work, tape/common-grid, precision and analytic interfaces remain assumptions. No unconditional theorem or new Lean proof is claimed.

Prepared by chafreaky with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit eumemic #436/#440/#441, our #417/#439 kernel and residual-route lineage, Rohan Arun #434/#435/#438, icekylinx #433, Zhihao Chen #425/#386, Dylan Crow #370, ai-nanachi #426, applecrusher #376, Jacob Sussman and the retained earlier contributors. Source-specific licenses, notices, assistance disclosures and exact pins are preserved.
